principle: Research destinations where a truthful current window is valuable to visitors. Existing/available travel programs help identify useful next-step categories, but may not lower source-quality or truth standards.

columns.visitorDecisionValue: How much seeing the place now could change timing/expectations
columns.sourcePriority: Research priority based on quality gap + visitor usefulness, not commission
columns.programFamilies: Program categories that may support the destination type; exact partner/destination coverage still requires verification

rows.why: Official visitor-condition cameras directly help with crowd/timing decisions; expand only source-specifically.
rows.next: Retest Nishiki Market only inside 11:00–18:00 JST; otherwise maintain four approved sources.

rows.why: Two truthful official external live windows exist; inside-ERN playback is not necessary for usefulness.
rows.next: Recheck unavailable official-tourism webcams only on material provider change.

rows.why: Official 24-hour Seoul Plaza live cam now fills the first visual gap, while separate official real-time crowd/traffic/weather context remains available for future Guide integration.
rows.next: Maintain Seoul Plaza; research additional distinct visitor-area visuals only if they add utility beyond the plaza/context layer.

rows.why: A current Sukhumvit Road live view now gives ERN a useful Bangkok street-condition window without relying on the reduced-stability BMA traffic application.
rows.next: Maintain Sukhumvit; seek a second distinct river/landmark/current-condition view only if quality is clearly stronger and non-duplicative.

rows.why: Strong visitor interest and direct relevance to ERN's local/farm origins, but Chiang Mai PAO cameras currently report standby/waiting.
rows.next: Monitor official feed state and build future For Places outreach to farms, resorts, markets and attractions with real current cameras.

rows.why: A municipal live park window directly answers whether a seasonal trip is worth making now.
rows.next: Keep one selective live window; do not import the full municipal camera network without distinct visitor need.

rows.why: The existing Chidori-ga-fuchi source is seasonal and the official Sakura page still shows April 9 bloom/congestion state in late September, so ERN currently has no in-horizon Tokyo visual window.
rows.next: Keep Chidori as seasonal/degraded until its next active season or fresh current evidence appears. Research a distinct year-round Tokyo street, market, park or transport-gateway current window from an official/high-quality provider.

rows.why: Multiple strong current landmark/skyline windows already exist; avoid commercial/source over-density.
rows.next: Maintain quality; new sources need a clearly different visitor use.

rows.why: Strong inside-ERN harbour view plus useful destination-specific planning actions already prove the model.
rows.next: Maintain reliability rather than adding density.

rows.why: Good beach/current-condition coverage; a distinct city/harbour view would add more value than another beach.
rows.next: Research official/high-quality city or harbour current window before adding more coastal duplication.

rows.why: Current beach view already answers a key visitor-condition question.
rows.next: Maintain; add only if a distinct surf/weather/city condition window is materially better.

rows.why: Major visitor destination; the official Eiffel Tower site exposes live attendance/opening/weather/summit-condition context, but ERN still lacks a verified current visual window for Paris itself.
rows.next: Preserve official Eiffel live visitor context as non-visual evidence only. Continue researching a rights-clear, high-quality current Paris visual source.

rows.why: A current Spanish Steps live view now gives ERN a strong visitor-activity window for central Rome.
rows.next: Maintain the Spanish Steps view; add another Rome source only if it provides clearly different utility such as Colosseum or Trevi conditions and remains current.

rows.why: A current port/skyline live view now fills the first Singapore visual gap; Marina Bay-specific provider pages are currently offline and remain excluded.
rows.next: Maintain current port view; recheck Marina Bay/downtown sources only on material provider change.

rows.why: Official current Arctic Circle village view strongly supports seasonal/weather/atmosphere decisions before a Lapland trip.
rows.next: Maintain one strong live village window; add another Finland source only when it offers a distinct visitor decision.

rows.why: NPS live stream directly shows geyser-basin conditions and happenings; ERN already has broader Yellowstone coverage.
rows.next: Maintain Old Faithful live plus broader park source; avoid duplicate geyser-window density.
